zh: 元素互不相同时，数组复原等价于下标置换回到恒等，把置换拆成不相交的循环来看。
长度为 k 的循环经过 t 次操作复原当且仅当 k 整除 t，所以整体复原的最小正次数是所有循环长度的最小公倍数。
用 seen 数组沿 p 走出每个循环求长度；LCM 可能远超 64 位，把每个长度分解质因数，记录每个质数的最高次幂，最后把这些幂相乘对 10⁹+7 取模。
en: With distinct elements, restoring the array is the same as the index permutation returning to the identity; look at the permutation as disjoint cycles.
A cycle of length k is restored after t operations exactly when k divides t, so the smallest positive number of operations restoring everything is the least common multiple of all cycle lengths.
Walk each cycle along p with a seen array to get its length; the LCM can far exceed 64 bits, so factor each length, keep the highest power of each prime, and multiply those powers modulo 10⁹+7.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Decompose the permutation into disjoint cycles; the answer is the least common multiple of all cycle lengths.

## Proof of correctness

An element on a cycle of length k returns to its place after t operations if and only if k divides t. The whole array is restored simultaneously if and only if every cycle length divides t, so the smallest positive t is the least common multiple of all lengths.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(n).

## Source notes

The constraints are complete; the direction in which the permutation is applied does not affect the cycle lengths or the answer.
